comparisons.note: baseline had model timeouts; do not attribute the entire receipt-latency difference to local changes

comparisons.instrumentation: same watchdog and detailed timing; cProfile disabled
comparisons.note: same application source; face-prepared calls the existing CPU face warmup before starting the source clock

production_changes: Prewarm every independent VLM worker before camera startup acknowledgment/source sampling; reuse clients.
Increase bounded connection-preparation budget from 2 to 5 seconds.
Disable redundant WebSocket compression at the application server entry point.
experiment_only_change: Move CPU face initialization before replay using its existing warmup method. No application face startup behavior was changed in this commit.
limitations: Single runs per diagnostic condition, not a repeated performance guarantee.
Cloud provider/network timing varies; local stages and no-new-TLS observations are the direct evidence.
Playback-only watchdog/loop metrics exclude preparation and shutdown. Raw logs retain those phases.
Failed prewarm remains bounded and fail-open; external disconnects cannot be guaranteed away.
warmup_requests: Credential-free HEAD only; no images or billed model generations.
